title: Tailoring hydrogenation, thermodynamic properties and oxidation resistance of TiFe alloy by only regulating the stoichiometric ratio of Ti and Fe elements
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,12348-12359
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09388K, Paper

Siqi Xia, Guojie Wu, Dongfang Huang, Guixiang Ma, Haonan Cai, Jinyuan Jiang, Quanbao Zhou, Xuebo Yan, Peng Lv
This study systematically investigates the effect of regulating the stoichiometric ratio of Ti and Fe elements on the microstructure, hydrogenation properties, thermodynamics and oxidation resistance of TixFe2−x (x = 1, 1.1, 1.2, 1.3) alloys.
